uncertainties: Kilsres, Crimson Tyrant, and Azure Sage Emperor are provisional terminology pending root research. Master's gender not supplied in this scene, so neutral references preserved.
text:
Please tell me.
It's simple.
I was there
at the moment it was born.
What!?
Shartos, the Azure Sage Emperor,
was born on this island.
No... You could say
it was because of this island
that the sword gained its present power.
Wait a minute!
Please, wait!
But Yard said the ones
who created this sword were
the founders of the Colorless Faction...
But Yard said the ones
who created this sword were
the founders of the Colorless Faction...
You don't mean...!?
That's right...
The same group of summoners
created this island
and that sword.
The Colorless Faction.
Wh...
Most of those
who knew that truth
are no longer alive.
By now, probably
only we Guardians remain.
...
I told you the summoners fought
among themselves and perished,
but that is only part of the truth.
To be precise... One summoner
rebelled against the faction,
and war engulfed the island.
Could that have been
the person you mentioned...?
Could that have been
the person you mentioned...?
Yes.
An outcast within the faction.
A summoner who dreamed
of making this island a paradise.
That was...
my master...
!
I was summoned
into this world
to serve as my master's Guardian Beast.
So...
that's how it was...
So...
that's how it was...
My master was
a gifted summoner.
This island was once barren.
It became what it is today
only through my master's power...
That was why my master
couldn't accept the decision
to dispose of this island.
So that led to the battle...
Faced with unexpected resistance,
the Colorless Faction deployed
that magical sword as its trump card.
The Swords of Sealing...
Shartos, the Azure Sage Emperor,
and Kilsres, the Crimson Tyrant.
The two swords' sealing power
robbed my master of most
of their magic, bringing defeat.
Driving them off and erecting
a barrier around the island took
the last of my master's strength...
And...
that's how things stand today.
To think this sword
was created for
